question: Can separately grounded room-door and furniture-door boxes, converted to independent SAM2.1 pixel masks, retain architectural door parts after a deterministic parent-box rescale without authorizing handled furniture or doorless openings?
single_change_from_pb14: Replace YOLOE joint open-vocabulary masks with one GroundingDINO call per frozen semantic class and an independent SAM2.1 box-to-mask source; retain the two-scale crop and competitor-conservative pixel topology.

grounder.load_contract: AutoProcessor and AutoModelForZeroShotObjectDetection from the frozen local snapshot, local_files_only=True, use_safetensors=True, float32, eval, CUDA:0.
grounder.license_boundary: The official model card at the frozen revision declares Apache-2.0; the local snapshot has no separate LICENSE file.

masker.load_contract: Sam2Processor and Sam2Model from the frozen local snapshot, local_files_only=True, use_safetensors=True, float32, eval, CUDA:0.
masker.license_boundary: The official model metadata and downloaded model-card front matter at the frozen revision declare Apache-2.0.

information_sources.source_boundary: Both pretrained inventories are unavailable, so exact SUN RGB-D training-image exclusion is not claimed. PB15 is Development-only and does not reuse any PB11-PB14 formal capture sequence.

runtime.execution_requirement: CUDA:0 must be available. Both snapshots, runtime, prompts, box postprocessing, SAM mask postprocessing, crop mapping, topology, and gate must match this protocol or execution stops before a valid formal result.

grounder.finding: Merged multi-class prompts decoded ambiguous phrases such as door door and handle hinge, so the formal contract binds class identity by one prompt per model call and ignores decoded text labels.

masker.source: in-memory synthetic RGB 320x240 with one box

cohort_freeze.prior_overlap: Zero capture-sequence overlap with all 32 formal PB11, PB12, PB13, and PB14 sequences.
cohort_freeze.positive_admission: Official annotation contains exact door and a handle, knob, push bar, or hinge label; human RGB audit confirms a room-scale architectural door leaf and visible operation part.
cohort_freeze.negative_admission: Official annotation contains no exact door; human RGB audit confirms a handled cabinet, wardrobe, closet, cupboard, or refrigerator door.
cohort_freeze.ood_admission: Official annotation contains no exact door; human RGB audit confirms a broad room or corridor opening without a spanning leaf.
cohort_freeze.diversity: Use at least four SUN RGB-D sensor/source buckets and no more than three frames from one bucket.
sealed_before_output: canonical source path and capture sequence
RGB, official polygon annotation, depth, intrinsics, and scene metadata SHA-256
role, official class-name evidence, and human RGB audit note
model snapshots, prompts, inference, box clamp, caps, mask mapping, topology, and gate

grounding.processor_text_call: Pass each frozen text as a single-element candidate-label list [text], never as a scalar string. Transformers 5.14.1 deterministically lowercases and appends the model-required terminal period to candidate-label lists.
grounding.postprocess: processor.post_process_grounded_object_detection(outputs, inputs.input_ids, threshold=0.4, text_threshold=0.3, target_sizes=[(H,W)]); keep strict score > threshold and ignore decoded labels/text_labels.
grounding.box_contract: Bind every postprocessed detection to the identity of its single prompt call and its postprocess index. Clamp xyxy independently to [0,W] and [0,H]; discard only non-finite or empty boxes. Do not apply NMS, cross-prompt deduplication, fusion, score calibration, or a second threshold.
grounding.parent_order_and_cap: Merge the five parent-call outputs, then sort by descending score, class priority cabinet_door, closet_door, refrigerator_door, doorless_opening, architectural_leaf, lexicographic clamped xyxy, prompt call index, and postprocess index. Retain at most 12 per frame.
grounding.child_order_and_cap: Within each parent crop, merge the five child-call outputs, then sort by descending score, prompt call index, lexicographic clamped xyxy, and postprocess index. Retain at most 24 per crop.

sam_masking.input: Use the exact clamped GroundingDINO box list, in its retained order, as SAM2 input_boxes for the associated full RGB image or exact RGB crop.
sam_masking.selection: Require exactly one bool mask per input box after multimask_output=False; bind by original box order. Ignore iou_scores and do not select, threshold, merge, morph, smooth, or resize beyond the official native-size postprocess.
sam_masking.mask_contract: Every parent mask must equal source HxW and every child mask must equal exact crop HxW. Record shape, true-pixel area, and SHA-256 of C-order uint8 mask bytes.

two_scale_topology.lane_1_full_frame: Run the five single-class parent calls on the full source RGB, retain the frozen top 12, and obtain one SAM2 source-native mask per retained parent.
two_scale_topology.lane_2_parent_rescale: For each retained parent box, use left/top=floor and right/bottom=ceil after clipping to source bounds, with no expansion. Crop exact RGB; run the five single-class child calls on that crop, retain frozen top 24, and obtain one SAM2 crop-native mask per retained child.
two_scale_topology.child_mapping: Place each child crop mask into its exact half-open source crop rectangle. Do not resize, dilate, erode, smooth, merge, or deduplicate.
two_scale_topology.child_representative: Mean integer x and y indices of all true mapped child-mask pixels; test source pixel floor(mean + 0.5), clipped only to source bounds.
two_scale_topology.assignment: Assign each child to the smallest-area full-frame parent mask containing its representative pixel. Break equal-area ties by cabinet_door, closet_door, refrigerator_door, doorless_opening, architectural_leaf, then lower stable parent index.
two_scale_topology.authorization: GROUNDED_SAM_PARENT_RESCALED_PIXEL_PART_TOPOLOGY is true if and only if at least one lane-2 operation_part or hinge child is assigned to an architectural_leaf parent.
two_scale_topology.negative_competition: Children assigned to furniture or doorless-opening parents do not authorize. A parent without an assigned child does not authorize.

metrics: per-frame grounded boxes, scores, prompt-call identities, SAM mask receipts, crop bindings, representatives, and assignments
per-class and per-subtype grounded box counts by lane
grounder and masker calls, latency, and peak CUDA memory

gate.development_promotion: All 4/4 architectural-door positives authorize, all 0/2 handled-furniture negatives authorize, all 0/2 large-opening OOD controls authorize, and balanced accuracy is 1.0.
gate.pass: Record a Development gate met, freeze this exact two-model pipeline, and test one fresh source-disjoint confirmation cohort.
gate.fail: Close this exact grounding/masking/topology route on the frozen cohort and change information source or representation; do not tune it on these pixels.

forbidden_rescue: After any cohort model output, do not change rows, roles, either model, prompt text/order, GroundingDINO thresholds, processor defaults, class binding, box clamp, caps/order, crop coordinates or expansion, SAM multimask or postprocess, mask mapping, representative point, parent priority, authorization, or gate; do not compare prompt, threshold, crop, model-size, or fusion alternatives on these pixels.
claim_boundary: PB15 is a current-frame RGB Development experiment. Even a pass is not source-disjoint Confirmation, exact target ownership, public access, open or closed actuation state, metric traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
